LEAVE AND LICENCE AGREEMENT
This agreement is made at Chennai between Sample Owner E (the Licensor) and Sample Tenant E (the Licensee).
Clause 1 Period
The licence shall be for a period of 24 months from possession.
Clause 2 Licence Fee
The Licensee shall pay monthly rent of Rs. 22,000 on the first of each month, and the rent shall increase by 5% after twelve months.
Clause 3 Deposit
The Licensee shall pay a security deposit of Rs. 66,000 (Rupees Sixty Six Thousand only) at signing, refundable within 15 days of vacating, less unpaid dues.
Clause 4 Supplies
In case of non-payment the Licensor may disconnect the electricity supply to the premises.
Clause 5 Possession
On default the Licensor shall be entitled to re-enter the premises and take possession.
Clause 6 Notice
Either party shall give one month's notice. The Licensor may enter the premises for inspection after 24 hours notice.
Clause 7 Registration
This agreement shall be registered, and stamp duty shall be shared equally.
Schedule A
Inventory: two ceiling fans, one geyser, one wardrobe, kitchen chimney. Maintenance charges of the society are included in the rent. The agreement binds any purchaser if the flat is sold. Disputes go to the courts at Chennai.
